source: MASSIVE 1.1 pt-PT, allowed train/development; reserved workers and original test withheld
hypothesis: Four learned token-position signals (single, start, end, interior) improve BIO span boundary transfer without increasing vocabulary, character buckets, hidden width, epochs or the seed.
representation: AXSQ0016 adds four bounded input rows to the existing relative-region split-head encoder. The feature is derived only from token position in the current input; it is not a label, dictionary, retrieval table or teacher query.
controls: Policy 0 is the frozen split-head control. Policy 1 changes only boundary_features. Development selects the winner; reserved workers and original test remain untouched until a separate audit.
scope: Diagnostic M1 experiment only. It cannot certify M1 or permit M2 unless every required gate is independently re-run under evals/protocols/m1-completion-v1.json.
